name: codex_explore
description: Start a new Codex session to explore/trace code or analyze architecture (read-only + gpt-6-luna + xhigh effort + default tier). Returns thread_id for follow-up via codex_resume.

effort.description: Reasoning effort (default: medium for sol, xhigh for luna).

model.description: Optional model override (default: gpt-6-luna; e.g. gpt-6-luna, gpt-6.2-sol, gpt-6.1-terra).

prompt.description: Task or question for Codex (include file/module hints if helpful).

writable.description: Allow workspace writes (default: false, strictly read-only).
